maya: Quick experiment idea: one-week 'Seed Surge' push — 100 credits + Prompt Starter Pack + 30-min live demo. Goal: lift signup -> first-generate within 48h by ~25%. :seedling:

sam: Nice. Primary metric = % new signups with >=1 generate in 48h. Secondary = day7 retention and credit redemption.

olivia: Ops: recommend auto-issue credits via /v1/internal/promos/issue and tag registrants with cohort=seed-surge. Exclude enterprise domains.

nina: Suggest two arms: (A) 100 credits + prompt pack, (B) 100 credits + guided console tour. N=300 per arm. Also test short nudge email at 12h.

chris: I'll draft 3 launch posts (developer, tutorial, benchmark) and a short benchmark sidebar for the blog comparing a 256-token median latency. Mockups: https://figma.com/s/seed-surge-mocks

sam: Tracking: utm_campaign=seed-surge, utm_medium=social/newsletter, prompt_pack=starter. Amplitude events: webinar_signup, promo_issued, first_generate. I'll build a small dashboard for same-day monitoring.

olivia: I'll wire the webhook->promo flow and prepare email copy with a one-click "Run this sample" CTA. Need final copy by EOD Thu.

maya: Launch copy idea: "Seed Surge: run real prompts today 100 credits + starter templates". We'll push to X, dev newsletters, and partners.

event-bot: Webinar scheduled: Seed Surge  Prompt Starter Lab on 2025-09-09 16:00 UTC. Registration: https://redwood.ai/webinar/seed-surge

maya: Great. Quick 15m sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm assets. :raised_hands:
